description: Source code for a Linux kernel module implementing DES encryption/decryption using hardware acceleration on Lantiq/Infineon platform. Contains driver registration, context management, and request processing for DES and 3DES algorithms, including ECB and CBC modes, with asynchronous request handling and DMA support.

methods.name: lq_des_setkey
methods.description: Sets the DES key in the context for encryption or decryption.

methods.name: lq_des3_ede_setkey
methods.description: Sets the 3DES EDE key in the context.

methods.name: lq_deu_des_core
methods.description: Main interface to hardware DES engine for encrypt/decrypt operations.

methods.name: lq_des_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data using DES, queues request.

methods.name: lq_des_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data using DES, queues request.

methods.name: lq_ecb_des_encrypt
methods.description: Performs ECB mode encryption for DES.

methods.name: lq_ecb_des_decrypt
methods.description: Performs ECB mode decryption for DES.

methods.name: lq_cbc_des_encrypt
methods.description: Performs CBC mode encryption for DES.

methods.name: lq_cbc_des_decrypt
methods.description: Performs CBC mode decryption for DES.

methods.name: lqdeu_async_des_init
methods.description: Initializes the DES driver, registers algorithms.

methods.name: lqdeu_fini_async_des
methods.description: Unregisters the DES driver and cleans up.
